scholarships.title: COMSTECH Research Fellowships for Least Developed Countries (LDCs) in the OIC
scholarships.official_source: OIC-COMSTECH (Ministerial Standing Committee on Scientific and Technological Cooperation of the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation)

eligibility: Be a citizen of an OIC least-developed country, or be employed by a research institution in an OIC country
Hold at least an M.S. or equivalent degree for graduate studies, or a Ph.D. for post-graduate studies, or be involved in active research
Be aged 35 or under for graduate studies, or 45 or under for post-graduate studies
Submit the completed form by email to COMSTECH headquarters with the full document set
existing.eligibility_summary: Open to young scientists and engineers who are citizens of an OIC least-developed country, or who are employed by a research institution in an OIC country, and who hold at least an M.S. or equivalent for graduate studies or a Ph.D. for post-graduate studies, or who are involved in active research. Age limits are 35 for graduate studies and 45 for post-graduate studies, with preference given to young scientists, particularly women scientists, at the beginning of their research career and those working in OIC least-developed countries.
benefits: Supervision and mentoring of local training
coverage: Supervision and mentoring of local training
requirements: Match the field: natural sciences, applied sciences, engineering and technology
Complete the application form and email it to khazima@comstech.org or comstech@comstech.org
Send a scanned copy of a valid passport
Send a CV of maximum five pages including publications
Send a supporting statement from the head of the home institution
Send two reference letters from senior scientists, where the head of the home institution cannot be one of the referees
Send M.S./Ph.D. degrees and relevant university transcripts
Apply for only one COMSTECH programme per calendar year
documents: Completed application form, emailed to khazima@comstech.org or comstech@comstech.org
Scanned copy of a valid passport
CV of maximum five pages, including publications
Supporting statement from the head of the home institution
Two reference letters from senior scientists familiar with the applicant's work, excluding the head of the home institution
M.S./Ph.D. degrees and relevant university transcripts
existing.english_requirement: Not stated on the official page, so none is asserted.
application_method: Review the published list of OIC least-developed countries and the CCoE host institution list
Email the completed form and all supporting documentation to COMSTECH headquarters in Islamabad
Applications are jointly reviewed by an expert committee of COMSTECH and the host institutions
existing.selection_notes: Research fellowships are awarded by COMSTECH together with the host institutions' Joint Scholarship Committee, based on scientific merit. The page states that an age limit applies but that preference is given to young scientists, particularly women scientists, at the beginning of their research career and those working in OIC least-developed countries.
existing.best_fit: Researchers and engineers from OIC least-developed countries - the majority of which are African - who hold an M.S. or PhD (or are actively researching) in natural sciences, applied sciences, engineering or technology, are aged 35 or under (45 or under for post-doctorals), and can commit six to twelve months to a placement.
existing.notes: This is a rolling all-year call with no published deadline. Unlike the women-only sibling fellowship, this scheme is open to all genders. The page itemises airfare, accommodation, subsistence, supervision and mentoring but does not state that tuition or enrolment fees are paid, so tuition_coverage is recorded as false and fully_funded as false. Applications are submitted only by email, unlike the sibling schemes that use an online form, and the page requires a valid passport where the virology scheme accepts an expired copy. COMSTECH permits only one programme application per calendar year, so this cannot be combined with the other COMSTECH fellowships recorded in this shard.
existing.duration: 6 to 12 months, extendable upon recommendation of the host institution
existing.application_period: Open all year on a rolling basis; the page records Call Status: 'The call is currently open'
existing.deadline_display: No fixed deadline; the awarding body states 'Applications / Nominations are open all around the year'
